connector.name: Vercel Deployment MCP
connector.registryDescription: Reference MCP stdio server for observing Vercel projects and deployments.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vercel-deployment-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the addiplus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
env.description: Vercel API access token used to read project and deployment information. Create one at https://vercel.com/account/tokens.

env.name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
env.description: Optional Vercel team (scope) identifier. Set this when the token belongs to a team so requests target the correct team scope.
